positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Businesses use Tremendous to send one-off payments to people around the world–for completing surveys, participating in user research calls, doing take-home projects, reporting bugs, booking demos, etc.

positions.title: Technical Lead, Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Led a team focused on fraud use-cases employing alternative data and industry classification—leveraging web data to verify business identities and surface insights. Helped grow and onboard a team of senior engineers, fostering a collaborative, supportive environment where engineers are empowered to move fast, explore creative solutions, and take technical ownership. Worked closely with product on roadmap development and planning, ensuring alignment across strategy and execution. Balanced leadership role with regular IC duties and code contributions.
positions.insights: Git, Ruby on Rails and +4 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Acted as a fullstack product engineer. Focused on the development of 0-to-1 underwriting products, including lien search, lien filing/termination, and litigation/bankruptcy search tools—built from scratch and delivered to customers. Spearheaded the simplification and redesign of the SOS document retrieval product, improving performance and market fit.
positions.insights: Ruby on Rails, Git and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Worked on Credit Platform Accounts team supporting Buy Now Pay Later installment products.  Developed multiple apps to manage loans, including mid-tier RESTful services, Spring batch jobs, asynchronous messaging daemons, and a database.

Outside of normal work duties: 
Helped plan remote hackathons.  Regularly attended online career fairs for recruiting.  Interviewed candidates and trained new hires.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
As a member of the new Platform Accounts team, designed multiple batch jobs, REST endpoints, database optimizations, and messaging daemon flows for consumer installment products.  Trained new team members.

Outside of normal work duties: 
Regularly participated in hackathons to benefit local non-profits.  Member of the IDEA team (Inclusivity, Diversity, Engagement, and Awareness).  Developed secure coding skills by participating in SecForce training program and Capture the Flag events.  Regularly attended career fairs and on-campus hackathons for recruiting.  Interviewed candidates and trained new hires.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description: Worked on PayPal Credit Authorization and Settlement team.  Developed features for credit underwriting.  Designed and wrote Spring Batch jobs to assist in migration of underwriting and settlement to third-party.

positions.title: Head Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Helped teach Fundamentals to Parallel Programming course (COMP 322).  Oversaw team of 18 teaching assistants.  Modified lab work and ran lab sessions.  Managed the course autograder for homeworks and labs.  Wrote module quizzes.

positions.title: Software Engineer Summer Intern
positions.description: Interned for Summer 2016 and Summer 2017.  Worked on Authorization Engine team for PayPal Credit using Agile Scrum development strategies.  Focused on migrating MDBs to a Spring-based context.  Independently created and taught HTML class for 9 to 13 year old girls.  Worked with PayPal’s Teaching Kids Programming initiative for 2 classes.

educations.degreeName: Bachelor of Science (BS) & Bachelor of Arts (BA)

courses.name: University of Michigan - Coursera Introduction to Natural Language Processing

honors.title: Marion I. & Henry J. Knott Secondary Scholar

volunteerExperiences.description: Independently created and regularly taught introductory HTML/CSS class for elementary and junior high students.
Mentored local high school student in her Edith Hamilton project (senior independent study).  Project involved building a web application for a school parking lot lottery system.

projects.title: Stock Trading Agent
projects.description: Created a Q-Learning based agent to trade stocks based on common market indicators.  Compared learning agent to a manual trading strategy.

projects.title: Plantation Park Heights Urban Farm Mobile Application
projects.description: Hackathon project for local non-profit organizations.  Developed an iOS application for a local farm to help coordinate volunteer schedules and field trips.  Allowed farm leaders to send announcements and view expected volunteers for each time slot.
